# Draft:Battle of Sauj Bulak (1918)

The Battle of Sauj Bulak (1918) was a major military engagement that took place in July of 1918 near present-day Mahabad in Iranian Azerbaijan, between the Assyrian volunteers led by Agha Petros against Ottoman and Kurdish troops under the command of Ali İhsan Pasha.  The Assyrians eventually emerged victorious, and Ottoman forces retreated to Rawandiz.
